text: The atmosphere here strikes me as both clinical and creative. The glass walls suggest transparency and openness, while the room beyond, with its neatly arranged chairs facing a projection screen, has an expectant, slightly tense feeling, as if ideas are waiting to be born. The second scene, with its bold colors and explicit emphasis on R+D, breathes energy and curiosity. I feel a subtle excitement, tempered by a sense of being observed in a space devoted equally to innovation and reflection. I am eager to see what questions this environment might invite me to ponder.
